thread:
Marta R: Morning — quick async pulse. What I did: validated yesterday's KV eviction tweak (no regression in eu-west), closed SRE-341. Blockers: hitting a weird 503 when autoscaler scales from 0->1 in staging. Today: triage autoscaler, file a small revert if needed, pinging oncall for context.
Kunal: Saw the 503s on staging at 03:12 UTC too. Logs show a 30s startup timeout to worker: `connection refused` then downstream 503. I have a patch to increase probe window to 60s; will test.
Priya S: FYI I bumped the canary ramp yesterday — metrics looked okay for 2h then a slight latency tail in p50->p95. I left notes in SLO dashboard. No blocking deploys.
Jose: For the autoscaler issue, could be the cold-start vram init on the new instance. I can add a warmup hook that preloads the KV shards. If you want me to try, lmk.
Marta R: @Jose yes please try a warmup hook in staging first. Add a short log line `kv:shard preload done` so we can correlate.
Ezra: Oncall handoff: I picked up the pager at 04:00. I acknowledged the spike, muted noisy alerts for the short window (rate limit + dedupe), and left a runbook pointer in the incident channel. No customer impact.
Kunal: Patch applied to staging probe, running a 30-min ramp. If stable I'll open PR with config and add to canary job.
Priya S: Small ask — can someone glance at my CR #4820 (observability: add per-route token breakdown)? It's low-risk but would be good to merge before end of day. @Marta R @Kunal
Marta R: I'll take a look after I push the autoscaler revert test.
CI-Bot: Build passed — infra-tests on staging (job 87912). Coverage unchanged.
Jose: Deployed a quick warmup in staging with the log line. Early checks: KV load took ~4s, worker ready at 8s, no 503 observed in short loop.
Marta R: Great — can we run the synthetic load from the dataplane for 10m and watch p95? I'll schedule it now.
Kunal: Running synthetic now. Also will add a temporary metric `autoscaler.cold_start_count` to help tune.
Priya S: Heads-up — set an alert on `p95 > 350ms` for the canary route; if it fires we auto-rollback. I added it to the rollout policy in console.
Ezra: Noted. Oncall follow-ups: I'll create a ticket to review alert noise sources and propose a suppression window for known flare-ups.
Marta R: Blocker update: if synthetic stays green for 10m and probe change looks ok, we can push the probe config to canary. If not, we'll revert the KV eviction tweak and re-evaluate.
Kunal: Synthetic completed: p95 stable (~220ms), no 503s. I'll open PR for canary probe bump and add unit test for probe timeout handling.
Marta R: Cool. Action items: Kunal PR + unit test, Jose confirm warmup in next 24h for prod, Priya merge CR #4820, Ezra file alert-noise ticket. I'll post a short note in incidents channel after the canary push. :thumbsup:
Priya S: I'll merge after Marta gives the green. Thanks all.
Jose: I'll schedule prod warmup during low-traffic window and notify ops.
Ezra: Ticket created: SRE-410 (alert noise triage) and assigned to me.
Marta R: Thanks — closing the loop. If anything spikes ping `@eng-sre` with `URGENT` prefix.
